root_readonly_git_observations.interpretation: Root reports most differences are CRLF/LF. Not every difference has been independently proved to be newline-only by this preparer.

guarantee: Exact existing Root4c raw byte preimages plus explicitly hashed source overlays reproduce the recorded candidate manifests. A matching Git commit alone does not supply that raw baseline.
not_guaranteed: Fresh clone plus52 overlay files, even with the6 archived generated inputs, is not guaranteed to reproduce the same raw App across checkout/newline policies.
required_verification: Recompute raw application-source-v1 and match the complete expected baseline before applying.
Verify every explicit before SHA, including non-App scripts/tests/docs. Stop on any mismatch.
Do not silently normalize839 files or force overwrite to make a hash claim.
Treat the6 archived egg-info text files as historical fingerprint inputs, never current installation metadata.
scope: Finite progress/review package; not a final portable release.
